en.title: No Pairs Allowed
en.description:
For each word in words, compute separately the minimum number of character replacements so that the result has no two equal adjacent characters. Each replacement changes the letter at one position; you do not need to output the modified words.

The full original ranges are kept; this site only wraps the standard input/output.
en.input: The first line contains n; each of the next n lines contains a lowercase ASCII word. Full original ranges: 1≤n≤100, 2≤(length of each word)≤100000; the total number of characters is not separately limited, so a valid total length can reach 10000000. The standard input/output is this site's wrapper.
en.output: Output one line of n integers separated by spaces: the minimum number of replacements for each word, in input order.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the companion notes for the approach, the correctness proof and the complexity.
hints: Split the word into maximal runs of equal characters. A run of length L needs at least one replacement for every two characters, for a minimum of floor(L/2); runs are independent of each other, so add up the results.
